topic: Anti-skid devices, purpose and operating principle of anti-skid unit.
syllabus_extract: Anti-skid devices, purpose and operating principle of anti-skid unit.
specific_objectives: 17.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to describe typical alighting gears of an aircraft and its construction.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of anti-skid system diagrams in IB; Instructor supervision required for diagram tracing.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the landing gear?
Why is braking necessary during the landing roll?
What happens if wheel rotation exceeds the limit during landing?

topics: Definition and purpose of anti-skid devices
Construction of typical landing gear units
Role of wheel speed sensors in anti-skid
Prevention of wheel lock-up and skidding
development.content:
Definition and purpose of anti-skid devices
Construction of typical landing gear units
Role of wheel speed sensors in anti-skid
Hydraulic pressure modulation mechanism
Prevention of wheel lock-up and skidding

topics: Signal processing from wheel speed sensors
Comparison of wheel speed to reference speed
Activation of solenoid valves for pressure reduction
Restoration of braking pressure upon speed recovery
development.content:
Operating principle of anti-skid unit
Signal processing from wheel speed sensors
Comparison of wheel speed to reference speed
Activation of solenoid valves for pressure reduction
Restoration of braking pressure upon speed recovery

topics: Benefits of anti-skid during landing and takeoff
development.content:
Benefits of anti-skid during landing and takeoff
System limitations and failure modes
Integration with automatic braking systems
Maintenance checks for anti-skid components
Troubleshooting common anti-skid faults

summary_questions: Explain how the anti-skid unit prevents wheel lock-up during landing.
Describe the sequence of events when a wheel speed exceeds the threshold.
How does the anti-skid system interact with the hydraulic braking system?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the differences between manual braking and anti-skid assisted braking, referencing the next lesson plan on under carriage components.
